entities.summary: Lombard League, a political institution in Italy during Medieval Communes and Maritime Republics (1000–1300). Grew from Maritime Republics — Venice, Genoa, Amalfi, Pisa. Led to the emergence of Communes and Guelph-Ghibelline Conflicts and Papal States and Avignon Papacy.
